description_en: Removes a group of users from a Cloud Call Center instance
description_zh: 调用RemoveUsers从一个呼叫中心实例中移除一组用户
name: RemoveUsers

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance from which you want to remove users
parameters.help_zh: 待移除用户的呼叫中心实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user to remove from the Cloud Call Center instance.


UserId.1 removes a single agent. To remove multiple agents, specify multiple parameters such as UserId.1, UserId.2, and UserId.3. For more information, see the request examples below
parameters.help_zh:
待移除的呼叫中心实例中的用户ID。


UserId.1意为只移除一个坐席，如果移除多个，则需要传多个，例如 UserId.1、UserId.2、UserId.3，以此类推，具体请参考下方的请求示例
parameters.name: user_id
